verdict.line: You lose if he reaches level 3-5 with Fury above 50 and E (Slice and Dice) up to chain into empowered W (Ruthless Predator); you win by surviving that window, banking E (Valor) as a block, and taking over once his dash is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Renekton's whole kit is gated by his Fury bar and a 16-10s dash — when Fury is above 50 his Q (Cull the Meek) heals harder and his W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a triple-hit 1.5s stun instead of a 0.75s one, and Slice and Dice lets him force that combo on you. Riven has no early tool that punishes this as hard as it hits her, so the 46.4% win rate over 707 games and Renekton's lane/solo-kill advantage both trace back to that Fury-gated all-in, not to anything wrong with Riven's kit.

theirWindow.what: He can dash in with E (Slice and Dice) and land a triple-slash W (Ruthless Predator) for a full 1.5s stun that also strips any damage-block you have queued. Do not stand and trade autos here — hold E (Valor) to eat the follow-up hit or disengage with Q (Broken Wings) charges before he closes.

yourWindow.when: His E (Slice and Dice) on cooldown, Fury under 50
yourWindow.what: He has no gap-close and his Q/W are at base numbers. Initiate with Q (Broken Wings) to close and W (Ki Burst) to stun first — you get the first stun instead of eating his, which is the only clean engage you have in this matchup.

powerCurve.note: Q sustain-heal and early W stun beat your poke
Fury all-in with E into empowered W peaks here
Dominus adds health/damage on top of the all-in
Eclipse spike and maxed Q let you trade back
Death's Dance sustain closes the duel gap

start.why: The AD and on-hit sustain help you survive his Q (Cull the Meek) poke-heal trades without needing to disengage every time he pokes.

boots.why: Renekton's damage is entirely physical autos and slashes, so the flat auto-attack reduction blunts his empowered W and Q chip more than move speed does.

core.why: The proc and shield give you a real answer to his all-in burst once you have it, which is the moment the lane starts evening out.
Converts his burst into damage-over-time you can heal through, directly countering the Fury-empowered stun-and-slash combo you're stuck respecting pre-item.
Sustained magic damage and healing keep you ahead in extended skirmishes once the early Fury spikes are behind you.

situational.when: he starts building armor or tanking up off Dominus procs
the game turns into repeated skirmishes and you need R (Blade of the Exile) and E (Valor) back faster to keep answering his dash
you're ahead and want to win isolated duels outright instead of grinding sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the forced trades he creates and heals you back through his Q sustain, then converts to true damage in the extended fights his Fury combo drags you into.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes his all-in the moment it's read wrong — his Q heal and Fury sustain both get cut, and it can close out a fight even after he lands the empowered W stun.

playing.title: Bank E for his stun
playing.detail: Don't spend E (Valor) just to close distance early. Save it to block the second or third hit of an empowered W (Ruthless Predator) once his Fury crosses 50.

playing.title: Track Fury, not just cooldowns
playing.detail: A full Fury bar means his next Q heals more and his next W stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Disengage before he caps it out rather than after.

playing.title: Punish the empty dash
playing.detail: E (Slice and Dice) is 16-10s on cooldown by rank. The moment he uses it to wave-clear or reposition, that's your window to engage with Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) before he can escape or re-engage.

playing.title: Don't extend past level 6 fights
playing.detail: Dominus gives him bonus health and AoE damage on top of an already-ahead kit. Fight to trade, not to finish, until you have Eclipse.

playing.title: Use Q charges to disengage, not just engage
playing.detail: Broken Wings' reactivations let you hop away mid-trade if he lands his stun — don't dump all three charges forward if the trade has already turned against you.

playing.title: Play for the Eclipse spike
playing.detail: The matchup is measurably closer from item 1 onward. Farm safely under tower pre-6 if he's shoving, and look to reopen the lane once Eclipse is up.

playing.title: Save Wind Slash for confirmed kills
playing.detail: R (Blade of the Exile)'s ranged Wind Slash is a one-time resource — use it to finish him after he's already committed Dominus and is out of Fury, not as an opener.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win-rate numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the Fury-timing and cooldown-punish reasoning is my own tactical read of the two kits, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Engage Renekton while keeping an eye out for his Fury. Use your abilities to deal burst damage and fall back to slowly gain control over lane.
